name: @dsar/backend
description: Backend route stubs for DSAR services.

scripts.dev: bun -e "import { dsarInstance } from './src/index.ts'; const basePath = Bun.env.BASE_PATH ?? '/api/v1'; const runtime = dsarInstance({ basePath }); const server = Bun.serve({ port: Number.parseInt(Bun.env.PORT ?? Bun.env.BUN_PORT ?? Bun.env.NODE_PORT ?? '3000', 10), fetch: runtime.handler }); console.log('DSAR runtime:', server.url); console.log('Status:', `${server.url}${basePath === '/' ? '' : basePath}/status`); console.log('OpenAPI:', `${server.url}${basePath === '/' ? '' : basePath}/spec.json`); console.log('Docs:', `${server.url}${basePath === '/' ? '' : basePath}/docs`);"
